metadata.title: KHẢO SÁT CHẤT LƯỢNG GIỮA HỌC KỲ I – SỞ GD&ĐT HƯNG YÊN – TOÁN 12 – 2026–2027
metadata.subject: Toán 12
metadata.department: Sở Giáo dục và Đào tạo Hưng Yên

sources.derivation: Four original JPEGs placed on four A4 pages with preserved aspect ratio; publication source bundle. Original JPEG bytes retained separately.

provenance.transcription: Printed source only; handwritten answer circles, annotations and auxiliary pencil lines excluded.
provenance.layout: Livestream edition following xuan-phuong-12-gk1-ma-1220-26-27: lesson heading with gradient DXT header logo, VIPDXT footer, black question labels with red [DXT] tags.
layout_adjustments: Two publication variants: de keeps the original five-page exam paper with tighter rhythm and the sensor grid placed below its prompt; de-cach adds Lời giải headings plus 9 mm ruled writing space and fills the page remainder.
Handwriting annotations omitted; no answer key or invented solutions added.

Figures placed beside or below their prompts; page 1 uses wider question gaps and extra variation-table spacing, page 2 ends at Question 10, and Section III Question 2 starts on page 4 and continues with its sensor grid on page 5.

figure_models.square-pyramid: Parallelogram projection of square ABCD; S vertically above A; SA, AB, AD hidden.
figure_models.sensor-grid: Exactly 15 positions in 5 rows and 3 columns at equal spacing; handwritten connecting lines excluded.
figure_models.number-staircase: Rows of 1 through 7 unit squares, total 28; A through G at rightmost cell of each row.

provenance.heading_revision: Department title 28pt stretched red; course banner 19pt to keep KHẢO SÁT CHẤT LƯỢNG GIỮA HK I TOÁN 12 on one line; original DXT logo with right-to-left lightening gradient header tab in header.

qa.content_review: All four photographed source pages read and compared to selectable PDF text; 12 + 4 + 6 questions, all options and 16 true/false statements retained in both variants. Handwriting excluded; no answer key or solutions added.
qa.figure_review: All seven standalone figure renders inspected; curve tick labels clear of guides and curves, pyramid A label clear of hidden edge; uniform table borders.
qa.text_bounds: Passed on all 5 de and 11 de-cach pages; body text within the 12 mm side margins, livestream header and full-width footer placed in the page margins; 22 red [DXT] labels and one final HẾT per variant.
qa.fonts: All fonts embedded; Times New Roman body, New Computer Modern Math, Arial course/title, original DXT logo with right-to-left lightening gradient header tab.
qa.full_page_visual_review: Passed: all 5 de pages at 100-150 dpi and all 11 de-cach pages inspected (de-cach: I.1-2, I.3-5, I.6-9, I.10-12, II.1, II.2, II.3, II.4, III.1-2, III.3-4, and III.5-6 with HẾT); heading banner one line, DXT tags red, footer aligned, writing lines and HẾT placement clean.
qa.publication_filename: Declared for de.pdf and de-cach.pdf; no upload performed.
qa.layout_revision: Livestream lesson layout: de keeps the original 5 pages with 1em leading, 2.5 mm paragraph spacing, wider page-1 gaps, extra variation-table spacing, and the 25 mm sensor grid below the prompt; page 2 ends at Question 10 and Section III Question 2 splits across pages 4-5. de-cach runs 11 pages with 1.2em leading, 9 mm ruled writing space, and ruled page-remainder fill before every forced page break; Section I questions grouped 1-2, 3-5, 6-9, 10-12; Section III Question 2 places the 22 mm sensor grid beside the prompt.
qa.heading_revision: Course banner reduced to 19pt to fit one line; department title 28pt stretched; header right-aligned and VIPDXT footer left-aligned per Xuân Phương.
